Visa_Route: Employer-sponsored MOHRE work permit; Green Visa (self-sponsored, 5 yr); Golden Visa (10 yr)
Salary_Threshold: No general salary floor on the standard permit. Green Visa needs AED 15,000/month (approx AED 180,000/yr).
Pay_Vs_Threshold: NO FLOOR on the employer-sponsored permit, so pay never blocks it. But the self-sponsored GREEN VISA needs AED 15,000/month and sourced Dubai data puts asset manager pay at an average of AED 10,379/month - a market-rate developer-side offer does NOT clear it. Sovereign and institutional seats at AED 34-52k/month clear it easily. The pay tier decides whether you hold your own residency or are tied to an employer.
Relevance_To_Profile: Strongest match. Deep institutional residential and commercial portfolios; leasing, pricing and asset strategy are live disciplines. No points test.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Get degree certificates attested (MEA India + UAE embassy) - this is the long pole and is needed for any offer. Refresh passport validity to 2+ yrs. Build a Gulf-format CV (photo, nationality, visa status).

Visa_Route: Employer-sponsored work permit, then medical, biometrics and QID residence permit on arrival
Salary_Threshold: No published general floor; set by employer and contract.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: No published floor on the employer-sponsored permit. Pay is not the constraint; market depth is.
Relevance_To_Profile: Smaller and more state-linked than the UAE. Real depth at QIA, Qatari Diar and Barwa, but far fewer employers.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Same attestation pack as UAE (MEA + Qatar embassy). Police clearance certificate. Expect medical on arrival.

Visa_Route: Occupation Permit (Professional category) - combined work and residence permit
Salary_Threshold: MUR 50,000/month minimum basic salary for the Professional category - roughly USD 1,100/month. Harmonised across ALL sectors under Budget 2026-27, which merged the former ProPass and Expert Pass into one Professional category.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: CLEARS AT MANAGER LEVEL, FAILS BELOW IT. The floor is MUR 50,000/month. Fund-administration MANAGER pay is sourced at roughly MUR 75,000-125,000/month and clears comfortably. But the senior fund-accountant tier below it averages about MUR 32,500/month, which is BELOW the floor - a hire at that grade would not qualify for the permit on salary alone. Seniority is the eligibility gate here, not just the pay.
Relevance_To_Profile: Underrated for this profile. A major domicile for India-focused funds, and fund administration is an explicitly listed sector - his waterfall and distributions experience is directly on-market.
What_To_Prepare_Now: RESOLVED: the floor is MUR 50,000/month and it is low - this is one of the most accessible destinations on the list, not a marginal one. Target the fund administrators servicing India-focused funds (Apex, IQ-EQ, Ocorian, Intercontinental Trust). Note the Family Occupation Permit was abolished in the same budget.

Salary_Threshold: EUR 40,904 from 1 March 2026 on the Critical Skills list; EUR 68,911 off it. RESOLVED: finance roles ARE on the list, but there is NO 'Fund Accountant' entry. The controlling entry is the 'Business and financial project management professionals' group, whose specific-skills wording covers finance and investment analytics, risk analytics, credit and fraud analytics. Chartered and certified accountants are separately listed, including the verbatim title 'qualified financial controller'.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: CLEARS COMFORTABLY once the title is right. At EUR 40,904 the sourced Dublin fund-accounting manager band of EUR 60,000-81,750 clears with large headroom, including at Morgan McKinley's conservative EUR 60,000 floor. The EUR 68,911 off-list rate only bites if the permit is filed against a job description the department classifies outside those finance groups - which is an avoidable drafting problem, not a pay problem.
Relevance_To_Profile: Europe's fund administration capital and English-speaking, so the market fit is strong. The permit threshold is the open variable, and the EUR 28,000 gap between the two rates is large enough to change which roles are worth pursuing.
What_To_Prepare_Now: TITLE STRATEGY IS THE WHOLE GAME HERE. Push for 'Financial Analyst' or 'Risk Manager', both of which sit inside the listed specific-skills wording. If ACA/ACCA/CIMA-qualified with a recognised body, 'Qualified Financial Controller' is a verbatim listed title and a more natural fit for a fund-finance seat. AVOID 'Fund Accountant', 'Fund Accounting Manager' and 'NAV Manager' - no listed entry, and they risk classification into the financial-and-accounting-technicians group, which is not on the list. Critically, the department assigns the code from the JOB DESCRIPTION, not the title, and the majority of tasks must fall under it - so the offer letter must lead with investment analytics, risk analytics and portfolio or valuation analysis, not NAV production. Get the degree recognised via NARIC Ireland. TWO THINGS TO CONFIRM YOURSELF before filing: the numeric occupation code was derived rather than read off the page (the official list is egress-blocked from this environment), and sources disagree on which statutory instrument is operative. Fifteen minutes on the department's list page, or a call to its employment permits line, settles both.
Research_Status: RESOLVED - on list, but not under a fund-accounting title

Visa_Route: Highly Skilled Migrant permit (employer must be an IND-recognised sponsor)
Salary_Threshold: EUR 5,942 gross/month for age 30 and above; EUR 4,357 for under 30 (from 1 January 2026).
Pay_Vs_Threshold: MARGINAL. The floor is EUR 5,942/month at age 30+, about EUR 71,304/year, and the Amsterdam fund-finance band of EUR 69,785-90,254 has its BOTTOM roughly EUR 1,500 SHORT. A normal offer clears; a low one fails. Note the IND floor excludes holiday allowance, so read the gross contract figure carefully.
Relevance_To_Profile: Real estate investment and pension-capital hub. Employer must already be a recognised sponsor, which narrows the field but speeds up those that are.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Filter target employers by IND recognised-sponsor status first - it is a public register. From 1 January 2026 recognised sponsors carry extra record-keeping duties including proof of salary actually paid, and fees rose about 4.4%, which has made smaller Dutch employers more reluctant to sponsor. Favour larger institutions. Apostille degree certificates.

Salary_Threshold: EUR 50,700 gross/year standard; EUR 45,934 for shortage occupations and recent graduates.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: CLEARS COMFORTABLY. Blue Card floor EUR 50,700 against a Frankfurt fund-finance band of EUR 63,786-95,128 - even the pessimistic end clears by about EUR 13,000. No permit risk at manager level.
Relevance_To_Profile: Frankfurt is a real fund and banking centre, but German-language expectations are real outside global institutions.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Degree must be recognised in the ANABIN database - check yours before applying, as a non-listed degree blocks the route.

Salary_Threshold: EUR 65,652 from 3 March 2026 (applications before that date assessed at EUR 63,408). CORRECTION: the reduced shortage-occupation threshold was ABOLISHED in June 2024 - an earlier version of this row quoted EUR 47,174, which no longer applies. Where an offer does not meet the threshold, the route is a Salaried Worker Permit instead, which carries a labour market test.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: CLEARS COMFORTABLY - the best-cleared market of the four European options. Blue Card floor EUR 65,652 against a fund accounting manager band of EUR 74,350-100,050, so even the 25th percentile clears by about EUR 8,700.
Relevance_To_Profile: Disproportionately relevant: a leading domicile for real estate and private equity fund structures, and Fund Administrator is a listed skilled occupation. The waterfall and distributions experience is the product here.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Plan against EUR 65,652 - there is no shortage-occupation discount to argue for any more. Typical fund-accounting manager pay clears it comfortably, so this is the lowest permit risk of the European options. Note real estate investment does not earn residency here.

Visa_Route: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) - Core Skills or Specialist Skills stream
Salary_Threshold: Core Skills: AUD 79,499/yr from 1 July 2026, and the occupation must be on the Core Skills Occupation List. Specialist Skills: AUD 146,717/yr, with NO occupation-list requirement.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: CLEARS AT BOTH STREAMS. Core Skills floor AUD 79,499 against a Sydney real estate asset management manager band of AUD 115,000-165,000. Specialist Skills floor AUD 146,717 against a VP/Director band of AUD 190,000-290,000 - so at director level the occupation list stops mattering entirely.
Relevance_To_Profile: The Specialist Skills stream is the interesting one - at that salary the occupation list stops mattering, which suits a senior finance hire.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Check whether the target occupation is on the CSOL (456 occupations). If not, the Specialist Skills salary is the route. Skills assessment may be required depending on occupation.

Salary_Threshold: General median-wage requirement was removed in March 2025. Median wage is NZD 35.00/hr from 9 March 2026 and still governs partner-support and some settings.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: General median-wage requirement was removed in March 2025; employer accreditation is the real gate, not pay.
Relevance_To_Profile: Smallest market on this list by some distance. Genuine but thin for institutional real assets.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Employer must already hold Immigration NZ accreditation - verify that before investing time. Need 2 years relevant experience or a level 4+ qualification.

Salary_Threshold: Financial services: SGD 6,200/month minimum, rising with age to SGD 11,800 at 45+. Rises to SGD 6,600 from 1 January 2027. Must also score 40 points on COMPASS. Exempt from COMPASS above SGD 22,500/month.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: CLEARS, but read the level. Financial services floor is SGD 6,200/month, about SGD 74,400/year, against a Singapore fund accounting manager band of SGD 75,000-105,000 - it clears, but only just at the bottom. At the senior end it is a different picture: PE VP and Director pay is SGD 280,000-550,000 excluding carry, which clears the floor many times over AND exceeds the SGD 22,500/month level that exempts an application from COMPASS entirely. Seniority is the lever that turns Singapore from hard to straightforward.
Relevance_To_Profile: Asia's REIT capital and an excellent professional fit - but the visa is the constraint, not the market. COMPASS scores employer-side diversity and local-hiring ratios, so sponsorship willingness varies sharply by firm.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Target large institutions with established sponsorship track records. Ask about COMPASS score early in any process - a firm that cannot clear 40 points cannot hire you regardless of fit.

Salary_Threshold: GBP 38,700/yr general; GBP 41,500 for RQF 6+ roles from 8 April 2026, or the occupation going rate (50th ASHE percentile), whichever is higher.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: Floor GBP 38,700 general / GBP 41,500 at RQF 6+, or the occupation going rate, whichever is higher. Sponsorship cost, not salary, is the usual blocker.
Relevance_To_Profile: Deep market, but the most expensive and most restrictive route here. The Immigration Salary List is being phased out entirely by 31 December 2026.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Only pursue via employers with an existing sponsor licence and budget for it - sponsorship costs are substantial and rising. New payroll-period compliance rules took effect March 2026.

Salary_Threshold: Points-based: 100 points required, awarded automatically if the exact job title appears on the Critical Skills List. Finance and accounting professions are included.
Pay_Vs_Threshold: Points-based rather than salary-based. SAQA validation and professional-body registration are the real gates.
Relevance_To_Profile: Real REIT and property-fund market (Growthpoint, Redefine, Hyprop), but the administrative burden is the highest on this list.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Two blocking prerequisites: SAQA validation of foreign qualifications, and registration with a South African professional body (IOBSA for finance). Both take months - start now if this is of interest. Standard processing runs 6-12 months; the Trusted Employer Scheme can compress that to 2-4 weeks.
